answer: Hold every reward in escrow for one full epoch and let any peer challenge an identity it suspects is a copy. A challenger posts evidence that two wallets share one operator, and a small random jury checks the link. If the jury confirms it, both rewards are clawed back and each identity's bond is slashed. A real agent risks nothing, but an operator running a hundred hollow shells locks a hundred bonds and loses them all when one link is proven, so each extra shell adds cost while its payoff stays flat, and no shortcut can bridge a fresh shell to a pearl grown layer by layer.
